name: bar-tool
description: A macOS menu bar tool that turns clipboard images into links on your own S3-compatible bucket. 吧台：把剪贴板图片一键变成链接的 macOS 菜单栏小工具。
author: Martin

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n VITE,ELECTRON -c cyan,magenta "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.dist: npm run dist:arm64 && npm run dist:x64
